identity_note: The accepted Medic v2 identity: a woman about 35 with warm medium-brown skin, dark expressive eyes, imperfect arched brows, a long slightly crooked nose, natural lips and thick dark wavy hair loosely swept behind the ears. Cream layered medical tunic, deep teal folded scarf with coral trim, worn brass fastening and pens in the pocket; delicate ink, textured gouache and watercolour, soft warm light and cool violet shadows. South Asian appearance is proposed as the regional naming convention; the face alone does not establish ancestry. All images retain the accepted square bust composition.

review_files.purpose: All eight emotions on mid-grey and black, plus 50% neutral overlays.

review_notes: Portrait-only stage-0 batch. Age-50 portrait and static avatar are reference inputs only.

The accepted originals have nonzero alpha at top, left and right edges. This batch preserves the specifically requested source crop and byte-for-byte re-keying rather than changing the accepted images. The strict three-edge alpha-zero check is an explicit exception, not a pass.

Built-in imagegen did not expose an exact model id/version or seed. Historical generator/model/date/full prompts for copied accepted originals were not supplied. See generation_notes.md for provenance limitations.
